严酷荒野：猞猁: 成群的叮人昆虫来了，将持续约三天。你在户外被叮咬的次数会远超平常，而且叮咬会不断累积。下雨、营地里的火（营火、火坑、壁炉或火炉）、往火炉里添入蛇草，以及待在室内，都能让虫群变得稀疏。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Fleas and Lice

Fleas and lice in your hair, clothes and bedding. They never leave on their own. Keeping yourself clean drives them out slowly; the smoke of burning bog myrtle or juniper, bog myrtle leaves or bug repellent salve rubbed on, and a herbal wash drive them out faster.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 跳蚤和虱子藏在你的头发、衣服和铺盖里，它们不会自行离开。保持身体清洁能慢慢把它们赶走；焚烧沼泽香木或杜松的烟、涂抹沼泽香木叶或驱虫膏，以及草药洗剂能更快地赶走它们。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Flea Bites
A few fleas and lice have found you. The bites itch: less comfort, and your stress stops easing.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 几只跳蚤和虱子找上了你。叮咬处发痒：舒适度降低，压力也不再缓解。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Fleas
Fleas and lice are breeding in your clothes and hair: much less comfort, and your stress slowly rises.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 跳蚤和虱子正在你的衣服和头发里繁殖：舒适度大幅降低，压力缓慢上升。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Infested
You are crawling with fleas and lice: far less comfort, and your stress keeps rising. Wash, smoke them out or use a herbal wash.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 你身上爬满了跳蚤和虱子：舒适度严重降低，压力不断上升。洗个澡、用烟熏走它们，或者用草药洗剂。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Herbal Wash

A strong-smelling mash of bog myrtle and dry juniper needles. Scrubbed through your hair, skin and clothes, it drives out fleas and lice and gets some of the dirt off. With Herbs and Fungi installed, a herb dragged onto it makes a stronger wash that clears them out completely.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用沼泽香木和干杜松针捣成的气味浓烈的糊。把它搓遍头发、皮肤和衣服，能赶走跳蚤和虱子，还能去掉一些污垢。安装了《草药与真菌》时，把一株草药拖到它上面，能做成更强的洗剂，把它们彻底清除。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Wash with Herbs
Scrub your hair, skin and clothes with the herbal wash to drive out fleas and lice.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用草药洗剂擦洗头发、皮肤和衣服，赶走跳蚤和虱子。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Wash with Herb Infusion
Crush the herb into the wash and scrub with it: a stronger dose that clears fleas and lice out completely.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把草药捣进洗剂里再擦洗全身：更强的一剂，能把跳蚤和虱子彻底清除。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Herbal Wash
Mash bog myrtle (fresh, dried or powdered) with dry juniper needles in a clay bowl to make a wash that drives out fleas and lice. The bowl is not used up.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 在陶碗里把沼泽香木（新鲜的、干的或磨成粉的）和干杜松针捣在一起，做成能赶走跳蚤和虱子的洗剂。陶碗不会被消耗。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Tooth Decay

Rot in your teeth. It never goes away on its own: honey, sugar and a lot of berries wear your teeth down, and so does time. Each stage hurts and wears on your nerves. Chewing a chewing stick, with a herb for more, wears the rot down a little at a time; in the worst stage a bad tooth can be pulled out, which clears it all.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 牙齿里的蛀洞。它不会自行消失：蜂蜜、糖和大量浆果会侵蚀你的牙齿，时间也一样。每个阶段都会让你疼痛，并消磨你的神经。嚼食嚼棒（加入草药效果更好）能一点一点减轻蛀蚀；在最严重的阶段，可以把坏牙拔掉，彻底清除蛀牙。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Sore Tooth
A tooth has started to go bad. It twinges when you eat, and your stress stops easing.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一颗牙齿开始坏了。吃东西时会隐隐作痛，你的压力也不再缓解。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Toothache
The rot has reached the nerve. Chewing hurts, you cannot think of anything else, and your stress slowly rises.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 蛀蚀已经伤到神经。咀嚼时疼痛难忍，你什么也无法专心去想，压力缓慢上升。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Rotten Tooth
A tooth has rotted through and throbs day and night, and your stress keeps rising. Chewing sticks can wear the rot down, or the bad tooth can be pulled out.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一颗牙已经烂穿，日夜抽痛，你的压力不断上升。嚼棒能减轻蛀蚀，也可以把坏牙拔掉。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Chewing Stick

A willow twig with one end chewed into a brush. Chewed on, it scrubs the teeth and wears the rot of tooth decay down a little at a time, but it is used up. With Herbs and Fungi installed, a herb dragged onto it makes a stronger dose.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一根一端被嚼成刷子状的柳枝。嚼着它能刷洗牙齿，一点一点减轻蛀牙的蛀蚀，但用一次就没了。安装了《草药与真菌》时，把一株草药拖到它上面，能得到更强的一剂。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Chew
Chew the stick and scrub your teeth with it to wear down tooth decay.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 嚼这根棒子并用它刷牙，减轻蛀牙。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Chew with Herbs
Work the herb into the chewed end and scrub your teeth with it: a stronger dose against tooth decay.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把草药揉进嚼烂的一端，再用它刷牙：对蛀牙更强的一剂。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Chewing Stick
Chew the end of a willow twig into a brush. Chewing it scrubs the teeth and wears down tooth decay.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把一根柳枝的一端嚼成刷子状。嚼着它能刷洗牙齿，减轻蛀牙。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Tooth Puller

严酷荒野：猞猁: 一把细长的金属钳，用来拔掉烂牙。它只对已经烂穿的牙有用，要花半小时，还会让你惊魂未定。拔上几次，钳口就会松动。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Pull the Bad Tooth
Pull the rotten tooth out. It clears tooth decay (sweets and time can start it again), but it takes half an hour and leaves you badly shaken.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把烂牙拔掉。它能清除蛀牙（甜食和时间还会让它卷土重来），但要花半小时，还会让你惊魂未定。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Tooth Puller
Work a metal bar into a pair of narrow tongs for pulling a rotten tooth. The jaws wear loose after a few pulls.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把一根金属锭打成一把细长的钳子，用来拔烂牙。拔上几次，钳口就会松动。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Let Blood

Cut your forearm with the athame and let a little blood run for the beasts. It leaves an open arm wound and raises Beast Affinity by 100 (it fades over about two weeks), the way a calling needs. You cannot do it while an arm wound is still open. It takes an hour and wears the blade.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用祭刀划开前臂，放一点血献给野兽。会留下一道未愈的手臂伤口，并使兽亲和提高100点（约两周后消退），召唤仪式需要这个。手臂伤口未愈时不能再做。耗时一小时，刀刃会磨损。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Let Blood by the Incense Bundle
As Let Blood, but done beside a lit Incense Bundle: its smoke steadies the rite and Beast Affinity rises by 150 instead. The rite burns up a little of the incense, which must be lit near you.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 与放血相同，但在点燃的线香束旁进行：烟气稳住仪式，兽亲和改为提高150点。仪式会烧掉一点焚香，焚香必须在身边点着。

严酷荒野：猞猁: 与放血相同，但在点燃的香炉旁进行：烟气稳住仪式，兽亲和改为提高150点。仪式会烧掉一点焚香，焚香必须在身边点着。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Call Rain

Point the athame at the sky and call the rain down. The clouds thicken and the weather is drawn to change at once, so rain is likely but never certain. You can only do it once every two days. It takes two hours and wears the blade.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 举起祭刀指向天空，唤雨降下。云层变厚，天气立刻被牵引着改变，很可能下雨，但并非一定。每两天只能做一次。耗时两小时，刀刃会磨损。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Call Rain by the Incense Bundle
As Call Rain, but done beside a lit Incense Bundle: its smoke gathers the clouds harder, so rain is likelier. The rite burns up a little of the incense, which must be lit near you.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 与唤雨相同，但在点燃的线香束旁进行：烟气让云聚得更厚，更容易下雨。仪式会烧掉一点焚香，焚香必须在身边点着。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Athame

A short bone-bladed knife with a hilt wrapped in blackened twine, kept for rites. It cuts and butchers like any knife. With it you can let your own blood for the beasts, or call down rain; a lit incense burner or bundle nearby makes either rite stronger.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一把短骨刃刀，刀柄缠着熏黑的细线，专为仪式而留。它和普通刀一样能切割、剔肉。用它可以为野兽放出自己的血，或唤来降雨；附近点着香炉或线香，两种仪式都会更强。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Athame
Blacken a bone knife with charcoal and wrap the hilt in twine to make a knife for rites.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用木炭熏黑一把骨刀，再用细线缠紧刀柄，做成仪式用的刀。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Requires some Insight.
Harsh Wilds: Rain Rite Cooldown
Hidden timer: how many ticks until the rain rite can be done again.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 隐藏计时：距离可再次唤雨还有多少刻。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Casting Bones
A handful of small bones, scraped clean and marked with charcoal, kept in a fold of hide. Cast on the ground, they show whether the eagle or the black bear is close to coming for your food.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一把刮净的小骨头，用木炭做了记号，包在一块兽皮里。把它们撒在地上，便能看出鹰或黑熊是否快要来抢你的食物。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Cast the Bones
Throw the bones and read how they fall. They show whether the eagle or the black bear can come for your food within a day. It takes half an hour and wears the bones a little.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 掷出骨头，看它们如何落下。它们会显示鹰或黑熊能否在一天之内来抢你的食物。耗时半小时，骨头会略有磨损。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Casting Bones
Scrape a few bones clean and mark them with charcoal to read the signs of the eagle and the black bear.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 把几块骨头刮干净，用木炭做上记号，用来解读鹰和黑熊的征兆。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Requires some Insight.
Bones: Both Raids Near

The bones fall in two piles, one pointing at the sky and one at your stores. Within a day of this casting the eagle and the black bear are both hungry again. From then on, whenever you are outside, the eagle may take game left lying on open ground, and, while autumn lasts, the bear may raid the food kept in your containers and stores.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 骨头落成两堆，一堆指向天空，一堆指向你的储藏处。占卜后一天之内，鹰和黑熊都会再次饥饿。从那时起，只要你在户外，鹰就可能叼走散落在空地上的猎物；而在秋天结束之前，黑熊可能会洗劫你容器和储藏处里的食物。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Gather the Bones
Pick the bones up and put them away.
Bones: The Eagle Is Near

The bones fall in a line toward the open sky. Within a day of this casting the eagle is hunting again, and from then on it may take game left lying on open ground whenever you are outside. The black bear cannot come within a day of this casting.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 骨头排成一线，指向开阔的天空。占卜后一天之内，鹰会再次开始捕猎，从那时起，只要你在户外，它就可能叼走散落在空地上的猎物。占卜后一天之内，黑熊不会来。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Gather the Bones
Pick the bones up and put them away.
Bones: The Bear Is Near

The bones fall in a heap, heavy end down. Within a day of this casting the black bear is hungry again, and from then on, while autumn lasts, it may raid the food kept in your containers and stores whenever you are outside. The eagle cannot come within a day of this casting.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 骨头堆成一团，重的一端朝下。占卜后一天之内，黑熊会再次饥饿，从那时起，在秋天结束之前，只要你在户外，它就可能洗劫你容器和储藏处里的食物。占卜后一天之内，鹰不会来。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Gather the Bones
Pick the bones up and put them away.
Bones: Quiet Signs
The bones fall loose and scattered, pointing nowhere. Neither the eagle nor the black bear can come for your food within a day of this casting.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 骨头零散地落下，没有指向任何地方。占卜后一天之内，鹰和黑熊都不会来抢你的食物。

The Faerie Realm
The other side of the fairy ring, where the fair folk keep their court. You cannot stay long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 仙子环的另一边，仙灵们在此设立宫廷。你不能久留。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Faerie Realm
Silver grass under a moon that never sets, and music somewhere out of sight. No raid comes for your food here, and no lynx or bandit follows you in. The ring will send you home before long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 永不落下的月亮下是一片银色的草地，看不见的地方传来乐声。这里不会有野兽来抢你的食物，猞猁和强盗也不会跟进来。不久之后，仙子环便会送你回家。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Ring's Edge

The ring of toadstools you stepped through, glowing faintly in the silver grass. Step back through it whenever you like; when its moonlight runs out the ring sends you home anyway, back to the grove you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 你穿过的那圈蘑菇，在银色草地上微微发光。你随时可以从中走回去；当它的月光耗尽时，仙子环也会把你送回家，回到你来时的林地。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Moonlight Left
The Ring Lets You Go
The moonlight fades and the ring sends you home, back to the grove you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 月光消散，仙子环将你送回家，回到你来时的林地。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The ring lets you go...
Step Back Through the Ring
Step back through the ring and return to the grove you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 从仙子环走回去，回到你来时的林地。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Enter the Ring

On a full-moon night, step into the ring and through it, into the Faerie Realm. You can stay a few hours at most: step back through whenever you like, and when the moonlight runs out the ring sends you home to this grove.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 在满月之夜，踏入仙子环并穿过它，进入仙境。你最多只能停留几个小时：随时可以走回来，而当月光耗尽时，仙子环会把你送回这片林地。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Wander the Moonlit Meadow
Spend two hours wandering the silver meadow. Fairyweed grows everywhere here; now and then you find spirit mushrooms, a sprig of mistletoe or a smooth grey stone.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 在银色草地上漫步两个小时。这里遍地都长着仙灵草；偶尔你会找到灵魂菇、一枝槲寄生或一块光滑的灰色石头。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Pixie-Led
Little lights bob at the edge of sight, and you follow them without meaning to. When you come to yourself you are somewhere else in the silver grass, and laughter fades away among the stems.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 小小的光点在视线边缘浮动，你不知不觉地跟了上去。等你回过神来，你已身处银色草地的另一处，笑声在草茎间渐渐远去。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Find Your Way Back
Walk back the way you think you came. It tires you.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 沿着你以为来时的路走回去。这会让你疲惫。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Harsh Wilds: Faerie Tricks
Hidden 0/1 switch: 1 while Faerie Tricks are on in the Harsh Wilds config.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 隐藏的 0/1 开关：严酷荒野配置中开启仙灵恶作剧时为 1。

Hidden counter: ticks until the fair folk may next play a trick in a realm.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 隐藏计数：仙灵下一次可在异境中恶作剧前剩余的刻数。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Moon Realm
The silver country behind the Moon Stone, where the moon hangs low and close. You cannot stay long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 月石背后的银色国度，月亮低垂，近在咫尺。你无法久留。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Moon Realm
A pale shore of silver sand under a huge full moon, and a lake as still as glass. No raid comes for your food here, and no lynx or bandit follows you in. The basin will send you home before long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 巨大的满月下，一片银沙海滩，旁边是一池平静如镜的湖水。这里不会有袭击者来抢你的食物，山猫和强盗也不会跟进来。不久之后水盆就会送你回家。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Search the Silver Shallows
Spend two hours combing the shallows and the shore. White feathers drift in on the still water; now and then you find moon moss, a few niter crystals or a bright flint.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 花两个小时在浅滩和岸边搜寻。白色羽毛随静水漂来；偶尔你会找到月苔、几块硝石晶体或一块明亮的燧石。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Silver Pool
The still water you stepped through, bright with the moon. Step back through it whenever you like; when its moonlight runs out the pool sends you home anyway, back to the place you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 你踏入的那片映着月光的静水。你随时可以走回去；月光耗尽时，水潭也会把你送回来时的地方。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Moonlight Left
The Pool Lets You Go
The moonlight fades and the pool sends you home, back to the place you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 月光渐渐消失，水潭把你送回来时的地方。

Step back through the pool and return to the place you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 走回水潭，回到你来时的地方。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Moonstruck
The moon is so near that you cannot look away. When you can move again your hands are shaking and your thoughts will not settle.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 月亮近得让你无法移开视线。等你能动弹时，双手在发抖，思绪也静不下来。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Shake Off the Glamour
Look away and breathe until the feeling passes. It leaves you strained.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 移开视线，深呼吸，直到那种感觉消退。你会因此感到紧张。

Hidden counter: ticks until the moon may next cloud your mind in a realm.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 隐藏计数：距离月亮下一次在异界迷惑你的心神还剩多少刻。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Harsh Wilds: Moon Glamour

严酷荒野：猞猁: 隐藏的0/1开关：严酷荒野配置中开启月之迷惑时为1。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Moon Basin

A shallow stone basin set beside the Moon Stone and filled with still water. On a full-moon night the moon lies in it as if the water were a door. Step into the moonlight and you may find the Moon Realm; you cannot stay long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 月石旁的一只浅石盆，盛满了静水。满月之夜，月亮躺在水里，像一扇门。踏入月光，你或许能找到月之界；你无法久留。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Step into the Moonlight

On a full-moon night, step into the basin's moonlight and through it, into the Moon Realm. You can stay a few hours at most: step back through whenever you like, and when the moonlight runs out the pool sends you home to this shrine.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 满月之夜，踏入水盆的月光并穿过它，进入月之界。你最多只能停留几个小时：随时可以走回来，月光耗尽时水潭会把你送回这座祭坛。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: You step into the moonlight...
Moon Basin
Set a stone basin of still water beside a Moon Stone. On a full-moon night, step into its moonlight to visit the Moon Realm. It can only be raised where a Moon Stone stands.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 在月石旁放一只盛着静水的石盆。满月之夜，踏入它的月光，便可前往月之界。只能在月石所在之处建造。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Known from the start.
The Underworld
The dark halls under the barrow, where the old dead keep their quiet. You cannot stay long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 古冢之下的幽暗大厅，古老的亡者在这里安静安息。你无法久留。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Underworld
Low halls of black stone and old bone, lit by a cold grey glow with no source. No raid comes for your food here, and no lynx or bandit follows you in. The stair will send you up before long.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 黑石与古骨砌成的低矮大厅，被一种不知来源的冷灰光照亮。这里不会有袭击者来抢你的食物，山猫和强盗也不会跟进来。不久之后台阶就会送你上去。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Search the Barrow Halls
Spend two hours going through the halls. Old bones lie everywhere; now and then you find ash from a long-dead fire, the bones of a great bird or a sulphurous stone.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 花两个小时在大厅里翻找。到处都是古骨；偶尔你会找到早已熄灭的火堆留下的灰烬、大鸟的骨头或一块硫磺石。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Way Up
The worn stair you came down. Climb it whenever you like; when the cold light runs out the stair carries you up anyway, back to the cairn you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 你走下来的那道磨损的台阶。你随时可以爬上去；冷光耗尽时，台阶也会把你送回来时的石冢。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Grey Light Left
The Stair Carries You Up
The grey light fails and the stair carries you up, back to the cairn you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 灰光熄灭，台阶把你送回来时的石冢。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The stair carries you up...
Climb the Stair
Climb the stair and return to the cairn you came from.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 爬上台阶，回到你来时的石冢。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: The Restless Dead
Cold hands close on your ankles and your coat, and a dry whisper asks you to stay. You can feel how little strength they are leaving you.

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Break Free
Wrench yourself out of their grip. It tires you and sets your nerves on edge.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 挣开他们的手。这会让你疲惫，神经紧绷。

Bless the Grove with Mistletoe
Hang a sprig of winter mistletoe in the boughs of an oak grove and bless it, the way the old rites did. The grove is made sacred, as with the base game's own blessing.

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Lynx Cloak

A light cloak cut from a lynx's leather. It warms less and shields less than the Lynx Coat, but weighs half as much. While your mind is open to the spirits it lends you a little of the lynx's climbing and ambush. MUST BE EQUIPPED TO WORK
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用猞猁皮革裁成的轻便斗篷。它比猞猁皮大衣保暖和防护都差一些，但重量只有一半。当你心灵向灵魄敞开时，它会赋予你一点猞猁的攀爬与伏击之能。 必须装备才能生效

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Wear
Lynx Cloak
Cut a light cloak from a lynx's tanned leather (its hide type, which no base-game animal gives) with a little twine and a needle.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用猞猁鞣制的皮革（基础游戏中没有任何动物会给出这种皮）加一点细线和一根针，裁一件轻便斗篷。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Requires Leatherworking 10.
Lindwurm Fang
A curved fang as long as a hand, drawn from the jaw of a lindwurm. It is good for nothing but the old rites: a carver can make a charm of it for the Dragon Spirit.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 从龙蛇颅中拔出的一枚手掌般长的弯牙。它只用于古老的仪式：雕工可以用它为龙之精魄刻一枚护符。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Dragon Charm

A charm carved from a lindwurm's fang for the Dragon Spirit and worn at the neck. It asks for no binding: while you wear it, a little of the dragon's watchfulness stays with you (Alertness Aid), only at its lowest level. It wears out after about four weeks of wear.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 用龙蛇牙为龙之精魄刻成的护符，戴在颈上。它无需缔结：佩戴时，龙的一点警觉会留在你身上（警觉辅助），仅为最低等级。佩戴约四周后会磨损。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Wolverine at the Kill

A wolverine has smelled the big carcass you left on the ground and is tearing at it, growling at you over the meat. Drive it off and it may turn on you. Let it feed and it fouls the carcass, and may leave you little but bones.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 一只狼獾闻到了你留在地上的大型尸体，正在撕扯它，护着肉朝你低吼。赶走它，它可能会反过来扑向你。任它进食，它会糟蹋这具尸体，可能只给你留下一堆骨头。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Drive it off
Half an hour of shouting and swinging. It tires you and sets your nerves on edge, and one time in four it bites before it goes. The carcass stays whole.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 半小时的叫喊和挥打。这会让你疲惫、神经紧绷，而且每四次就有一次它会在离开前咬你一口。尸体保持完整。

Harsh Wilds: Lynx: Let it feed
Keep your distance. It gorges and fouls the carcass, so it keeps for less time, and if it was already going off it may be spoiled outright.
严酷荒野：猞猁: 保持距离。它会狼吞虎咽并糟蹋这具尸体，使其保存时间变短；如果尸体本已开始变质，可能会直接腐坏。
